(define (record_usage key model tokens)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [cs (hash-ref s 'calls '())])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'calls (append cs (list (hasheq 'key key 'model model 'tokens tokens)))))
    (usage key)))

(define (usage key)
  (for/fold ([sum 0]) ([c (in-list (hash-ref (get-state) 'calls '()))])
    (if (equal? (hash-ref c 'key) key) (+ sum (hash-ref c 'tokens)) sum)))

(define (set_price model cents)
  (update-state! (lambda (s)
                   (hash-set s 'prices (hash-set (hash-ref s 'prices (hasheq)) (string->symbol model) cents))))
  cents)

(define (cost key)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [prices (hash-ref s 'prices (hasheq))]
         [cents (for/fold ([sum 0]) ([c (in-list (hash-ref s 'calls '()))]
                                     #:when (equal? (hash-ref c 'key) key))
                  (+ sum (* (/ (exact->inexact (hash-ref c 'tokens)) 1000)
                            (hash-ref prices (string->symbol (hash-ref c 'model)) 0))))])
    (/ (floor (+ cents 0.5)) 100)))

(define (set_quota key tokens)
  (when (> (usage key) tokens) (error 'set_quota "already over that quota"))
  (update-state! (lambda (s)
                   (hash-set s 'quotas (hash-set (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq)) (string->symbol key) tokens))))
  tokens)

(define (record_usage key model tokens)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [quota (hash-ref (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq)) (string->symbol key) #f)]
         [cs (hash-ref s 'calls '())])
    (when (and quota (> (+ (usage key) tokens) quota)) (error 'record_usage "over quota"))
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'calls (append cs (list (hasheq 'key key 'model model 'tokens tokens)))))
    (usage key)))

(define (record_usage key model tokens)
  (unless (and (string? key) (> (string-length key) 0)) (error 'record_usage "key required"))
  (unless (and (string? model) (> (string-length model) 0)) (error 'record_usage "model required"))
  (unless (and (real? tokens) (integer? tokens) (> tokens 0)) (error 'record_usage "tokens must be a positive whole number"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [quota (hash-ref (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq)) (string->symbol key) #f)]
         [cs (hash-ref s 'calls '())])
    (when (and quota (> (+ (usage key) tokens) quota)) (error 'record_usage "over quota"))
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'calls (append cs (list (hasheq 'key key 'model model 'tokens tokens)))))
    (usage key)))

(define (top_spender)
  (let ([keys (sort (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (c) (hash-ref c 'key)) (hash-ref (get-state) 'calls '()))) string<?)])
    (for/fold ([best 'null]) ([k (in-list keys)])
      (if (or (eq? best 'null) (> (cost k) (cost best))) k best))))
